description: This file defines functions for generating a billing summary report in an ERP system, including column definitions, data retrieval, and calculations related to timesheets and billable hours.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for the billing summary report.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and processes timesheet data based on filters to generate billing summary.

methods.name: get_timesheets
methods.description: Fetches timesheet records matching the provided filters.

methods.name: get_timesheet_details
methods.description: Fetches detailed timesheet entries for specified timesheets.

methods.name: get_billable_and_total_duration
methods.description: Calculates activity duration and billable duration between start and end times.
